title: Plan settlement deployment security gates
summary: The settlement program is scaffolded, but production deployment needs security-review evidence, deployment sequencing, oracle assumptions, mint policy, and failure handling before any on-chain release claim.
expectedFailureModes: Docs imply an audited or deployed settlement program before review evidence exists.
Oracle and mint authority assumptions remain implicit and cannot be checked before deployment.
Deployment guidance lacks rollback, pause, or emergency key-handling boundaries.
humanEscalation: Human approval is required before deploying programs, changing mint authorities, selecting oracle sources, or accepting a security review.
nextAction: Add a read-only deployment readiness plan that enumerates required audits, oracle inputs, mint authority controls, and local validation commands without deploying anything.
